definition.def: An item is one of a collection or list of objects.
examples: The most valuable item on show will be a Picasso drawing.
The menu includes the occasional off-beat item.

definition.def: An item is one of a list of things for someone to do, deal with, or talk about.
examples: The other item on the agenda is the tour.

definition.def: An item is a report or article in a newspaper or magazine, or on television or radio.
examples: There was an item in the paper about him.

definition.def: If you say that two people are an item, you mean that they are having a romantic or sexual relationship. [informal]
examples: She and Gino were an item.

examples.sentence: Another motive for collecting is the desire to find something special, or a particular example of the collected item, such as a rare early recording by a particular singer.
